title: Causal diagnostics copy local error chains (anyhow {:#}, PersistFenceError Debug) into causalFailure.message
outcome: Causal diagnostics copy local error chains (anyhow {:#}, PersistFenceError Debug) into causalFailure.message
acceptance: Local preparation and durability failures reach the persisted and rendered causalFailure.message only as constant categories (for example 'local persistence failed; durability unknown'), with the full chain kept only in host logs; a sentinel test with a corrupt stored row and a failing write shows no serde Display text or DB path in the stored record or on the wire.
